reasons.claim: 3.18 ha regeneration felling notification in Västervik, status notified; completed felling overlap is only 0.002 ha (0.1%) from a 2016 felling.

One eligible species: Goodyera repens (VU vascular plant, site-bound, forest-associated; threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness), 11 records, nearest 803 m from the polygon (2025, 10 m uncertainty). Beyond 250 m, within 1000 m; none within 250 m.
Zero records inside the polygon or within 250 m (0 days), while effort within 1000 m is adequate (402 records, 90th percentile, county median 129.5). The county median within 250 m is 1.5 records.

Site-bound forest NT fungi (Porodaedalea pini, Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum, Hydnellum ferrugineum) were recorded only at 475–874 m, so the 3-NT-within-250 m criterion is not met. Other threatened records are mostly mobile birds, which are supporting evidence only.

uncertainties: Records show a species was recorded, not that it occupies the polygon today.
The nearest eligible record is about 800 m away, close to the edge of the 1000 m ring.
No records within 250 m may reflect nobody having recorded there: near-site effort is zero.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occurs on the felling site.
Forest age, structure or dead-wood content of the stand.
Legality of the felling or any measure of biodiversity.
next_action: Reviewer should check the stand for dead wood and old-forest features and consider a field survey, using the Goodyera repens and NT fungi records at roughly 475–900 m as context.
